inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped MySQL query folds key/value attribute rows into one JSON object per owning identifier with JSON_OBJECTAGG.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized independently authored regression with one catalog item and two unique attributes. It isolates JSON_OBJECTAGG result metadata and object-member ordering without joins or multiple groups.

fixture_notes: Catalog item 7 has two unique attributes inserted in b-then-a order. The two-key object isolates aggregate result metadata and member ordering.
determinism_notes: The query orders by the unique catalog item ID; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE catalog_attribute_pairs (item_id INT NOT NULL, attribute_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, attribute_value VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT item_id, JSON_OBJECTAGG(attribute_name, attribute_value) AS attributes FROM catalog_attribute_pairs GROUP BY item_id ORDER BY item_id
